newsitem.title: USA: Ford sets Q4 incentives on 1996, 1997 models.
newsitem.headline: Ford sets Q4 incentives on 1996, 1997 models.

text.p: Ford Motor Co. Wednesday announced a variety of cash rebates and financing incentives on certain 1996- and 1997-model vehicles in the fourth quarter, including a $500 rebate on 1997 Taurus and Sable cars.

Other 1997 Ford Division models that will have cash rebates include the Aspire, Escort, Probe, Mustang, Contour and Thunderbird cars, the Ranger pickup, and the Windstar and Aerostar minivans. Some of these vehicles will also have rebates on 1996 models.
Mercury Division vehicles with rebates include the Tracer, Mystique and Cougar cars and Villager minivans.
Ford is also offering a variety of annual percentage rate financing incentives, ranging from 3.9 percent for 24 months to 7.9 percent for 48 months.
Ford's stock rose 25 cents to $31.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
